scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm --workspace @flighthunter/shared run build && npm --workspace @flighthunter/server run build && npm --workspace @flighthunter/client run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build --force packages/shared packages/server packages/client && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
